06
Things I carry with me
Distance
每个人都会有过去。
就算你是一个杀手，一样会有小学同学。
"Everyone has a past. Even a killer has elementary-school classmates."
— Fallen Angels (1995), dir. Wong Kar-wai
Sometimes it's funny to think how far my life has taken me from the kids I grew up with — a place where I'd never run into any of them.
Resilience
New York is a resilient city,
just like you.
— Prof. Kathy Kiely
Said to me in Missouri, while I worked hard toward something bigger. Soon after, I packed up and drove to New York by myself.
Authenticity
Authenticity is a survival need.
— Dr. Gabor Maté
The line that named something I'd lived before I could explain it — how much of becoming myself meant refusing to disappear.
Relationship
I love lovers.
— Dr. Lexx Brown-James, LMFT, CSE, CSES
How I came to understand that everything is relational, and found my way toward relationship & sex therapy.
